description: List an event's tickets — one per attendee — newest first, with name, email, company, reference, release, price paid and state. Filter by free text (name, email, phone, reference, company, tag), state, type, release, activity, and created/updated time. Void tickets are excluded unless states includes 'void'. Tito: GET /:account/:event/tickets.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

activity_ids.description: Only tickets attached to these activity ids (search[activity_ids][]).

created_after.description: Only tickets created after this time (search[created_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

created_before.description: Only tickets created before this time (search[created_at][lt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

q.description: Free-text search: email, name, phone, slug, reference, company or tag.

release_slugs.description: Only tickets of these releases, by release slug (search[release_ids][]).

sort.description: Sort attribute (search[sort]). Default created_at, newest first.

states.description: Only these states (search[states][]). 'archived' also includes tickets of archived releases.

types.description: manual = added by an organiser, standard = ordered by a customer (search[types][]).

updated_after.description: Only tickets updated after this time (search[updated_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

view.description: Response view. Lists default to 'short'; 'extended' includes associated records but can be slow and large.

name: tito_list_tickets
title: List tickets (attendees)
